InputPrompt: Develop a calculator program that evaluates mathematical expressions with support for basic arithmetic operations, operator precedence with parentheses, exponentiation, logarithmic functions, absolute value, and factorial. The program should correctly detect and handle invalid expressions and edge cases, without using eval or ast.literal_eval.

UseCaseLIst.description: Parse expressions containing addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
Correctly evaluate expressions with parentheses and operator precedence.
Support exponentiation, logarithmic operations, absolute value, and factorial.
Evaluate expressions using a custom parsing or evaluation strategy instead of built-in eval functions.
Detect and handle malformed expressions and illegal operations gracefully.

InputPrompt: Implement a unit conversion program that supports conversions within length, weight, and temperature categories, including both linear and non-linear conversions. The program should correctly handle unknown units and invalid cross-category conversions.

UseCaseLIst.description: Convert between common length units using linear scaling.
Convert between common weight units using linear scaling.
Support non-linear temperature conversions such as Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin.
Ensure conversions are only allowed within the same unit category.
Gracefully handle unsupported or unknown units.

InputPrompt: Develop a two-player Reversi (Othello) game that supports human-vs-human gameplay on an even-sized board (3 < n < 26). The system should fully implement rule validation, piece flipping, turn management, game state updates, win condition detection, and illegal move handling.

UseCaseLIst.description: Initialize a valid Reversi board with configurable even dimensions.
Validate whether a move is legal according to Reversi rules.
Flip opponent pieces correctly after a valid move.
Alternate turns between two human players.
Detect game completion and determine the winner.

InputPrompt: Implement an offline fitness training record application that provides a built-in exercise library, supports custom training plan creation, records workout details including exercises, sets, repetitions, weights, and duration, and maintains training history, streaks, and statistical summaries.

UseCaseLIst.description: Provide a built-in exercise library with basic exercise descriptions.
Allow users to create and manage personalized training plans.
Record exercises, sets, repetitions, weights, and duration during workouts.
Store and retrieve historical workout records.
Maintain consecutive training streaks and aggregate statistics.

InputPrompt: Develop a diary application that allows users to create, edit, and view personal diary entries with rich text formatting, image insertion, keyword search, calendar and list views, daily reminders, and diary export functionality.

UseCaseLIst.description: Support bold, italic, and underline formatting with persistent display.
Allow insertion, viewing, and removal of a single image per diary entry.
Browse diary entries via chronological list and calendar views.
Search diary entries using keywords.
Support daily reminders and diary export.

InputPrompt: Implement a language learning application that supports personalized study plans, multiple target languages, a lesson tree with progressive unlocking, teaching and exercise phases, health, XP, and coin systems, daily goals, streak tracking, item usage, and independent progress tracking per language.

UseCaseLIst.description: Allow users to configure target language and daily learning goals.
Unlock lessons sequentially using a structured lesson tree.
Support translation, multiple-choice, and fill-in-the-blank exercises using word blocks.
Implement health, XP, coins, daily goals, and streak tracking.
Maintain independent progress and statistics for each language.
